questions.question: When Israel settled in the land God was giving them, how many cities did Moses tell them to set apart?
Moses said a man who killed his neighbor by accident should flee to a set-apart city. Why?

answers.text: The avenger of blood might chase him down
The elders might sell him as a servant
The priests might bar him from worship

questions.question: Moses said one witness was not enough to prove someone did wrong. How many witnesses did it take?
What did Moses tell Israel to do to a witness proven to have falsely accused his brother?

answers.text: Do to him what he meant to do to his brother
Make him pay a fine to the priests
Send him away to live in another town
